title: Here’s a Way to Predict When AI Chatbots Will Turn Bad
summary: Physicists at George Washington University claim to have developed a formula capable of predicting when an AI chatbot's performance will degrade from accurate to erroneous. Initial tests conducted on smaller AI models reportedly support the efficacy of this predictive method. This research could offer a new tool for AI reliability assessment.

title: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could create billions of dollars in XRP from nothing
source: CoinDesk: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Crypto News and Price Data
summary: The XRP Ledger has successfully patched a critical, decade-old bug that had the potential to illicitly generate billions of dollars worth of XRP. This vulnerability, if exploited, could have severely impacted the integrity and supply of XRP. The fix addresses a significant security flaw in the network.

title: This Sam Altman-Backed Life Insurer Runs Entirely on Bitcoin, and Just Raised $37.5 Million
summary: Meanwhile, a Bermuda-based life insurer operating entirely on Bitcoin, has successfully raised $37.5 million in funding. The investment round was led by Bain Capital Crypto, following a year of record demand from high-net-worth individuals globally. The company offers life insurance policies denominated and managed in Bitcoin.

title: Justin Sun says Tron’s post-quantum cryptography has gone live on testnet
summary: Justin Sun announced that Tron's post-quantum cryptography solution has been successfully deployed on its testnet. This development aims to prepare the Tron network for potential threats from quantum computing. Sun indicated readiness to implement quantum resistance on the mainnet in the near future.

title: CFTC Draws the Line Between Prediction Markets and Gambling in New Rules
summary: The U.S. CFTC has proposed new rules to classify event contracts, including those for sports and politics, as "swaps," thereby bringing them under its regulatory jurisdiction. Concurrently, an interim rule explicitly excludes casino-style gambling from this definition. These actions aim to clarify the agency's authority over prediction markets.
